meta.parties: Somasunderam Chetty Et Al. v. Vander Poorten

rules.statement: The plaintiffs are not entitled to ask for a reconveyance of the land on payment of the purchase money or for an accounting till the land has been sold by the defendant.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held further , that the plaintiffs were not entitled to ask for a reconveyance of the land on payment of the purchase money or for an accounting till the land had been sold by the defendant."
